verses.1:1: Now the LORD called to Moses and spoke to him out of the tent of meeting, saying,
verses.1:2: "Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, 'When any person from among you presents an offering to the LORD, from the livestock, from the herd and from the flock, you shall present your offering.
verses.1:3: If his offering is a burnt offering from the herd, he shall present an unblemished male; he shall present it at the entrance of the tent of meeting, for his acceptance before the LORD.
verses.1:4: He shall press his hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it will be accepted on his behalf to make atonement for him.
verses.1:5: He shall slaughter the young bull before the LORD, and the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall present the blood and dash the blood all around against the altar that is at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
verses.1:6: Then he shall skin the burnt offering and cut it up into its pieces.
verses.1:7: Then the sons of Aaron the priest shall place fire on the altar and set wood in order on the fire.
verses.1:8: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall set the pieces, the head, and the suet in order on the wood that is on the fire that is on the altar.
verses.1:9: Its inner parts and its legs he shall wash with water, and the priest shall turn all of it into smoke on the altar, a burnt offering, a fire offering of a soothing fragrance to the LORD.
verses.1:10: Now if his offering is from the flock, from the sheep or from the goats, for a burnt offering, he shall present an unblemished male.
verses.1:11: He shall slaughter it on the north side of the altar before the LORD, and the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall dash its blood against the altar all around.
verses.1:12: Then he shall cut it up into its pieces, along with its head and its suet, and the priest shall set them in order on the wood that is on the fire that is on the altar.
verses.1:13: But the inner parts and the legs he shall wash with water, and the priest shall present all of it and turn it into smoke on the altar; it is a burnt offering, a fire offering of a soothing fragrance to the LORD.
verses.1:14: Now if his offering to the LORD is a burnt offering from the birds, then he shall present his offering from the turtledoves or from the young pigeons.
verses.1:15: And the priest shall present it at the altar, pinch off its head, and turn it into smoke on the altar, and its blood shall be drained out against the wall of the altar.
verses.1:16: Then he shall remove its crop with its feathers and throw it beside the altar on the east side, to the place of the ashes.
verses.1:17: He shall tear it open by its wings, but he shall not separate it; and the priest shall turn it into smoke on the altar, on the wood that is on the fire; it is a burnt offering, a fire offering of a soothing fragrance to the LORD.'"
verses.2:1: "When a person presents an offering of grain to the LORD, fine flour shall be his offering; he shall pour oil over it and place frankincense upon it.
verses.2:2: Then he shall bring it to the sons of Aaron, the priests, and he shall scoop out from it his full handful of its fine flour and of its oil, along with all its frankincense; and the priest shall turn its memorial portion into smoke on the altar, a fire offering of a soothing fragrance to the LORD.
verses.2:3: And what remains from the grain offering belongs to Aaron and his sons; it is most holy from the fire offerings of the LORD.
verses.2:4: Now when you present an offering of grain baked in an oven, it shall be unleavened loaves of fine flour mixed with oil, or unleavened wafers brushed with oil.
verses.2:5: And if your offering is a grain offering on a griddle, it shall be fine flour mixed with oil, unleavened.
verses.2:6: Break it into morsels and pour oil over it; it is a grain offering.
verses.2:7: And if your offering is a grain offering from a deep pan, it shall be made of fine flour in oil.
verses.2:8: Then you shall bring to the LORD the grain offering that is made from these; it shall be presented to the priest, and he shall bring it near to the altar.
verses.2:9: And the priest shall lift out from the grain offering its memorial portion and turn it into smoke on the altar, a fire offering of a soothing fragrance to the LORD.
verses.2:10: And what remains from the grain offering belongs to Aaron and his sons; it is most holy from the fire offerings of the LORD.
verses.2:11: No grain offering that you present to the LORD shall be made leavened, for you shall not turn any leaven or any honey into smoke as a fire offering to the LORD.
verses.2:12: As an offering of firstfruits you may present them to the LORD, yet they shall not go up onto the altar for a soothing fragrance.
verses.2:13: And you shall season every grain offering of yours with salt, and you shall not allow the salt of the covenant of your God to be lacking from your grain offering; with every offering of yours you shall present salt.
verses.2:14: And if you present a grain offering of firstfruits to the LORD, you shall present young ears of grain parched in the fire, crushed fresh grain, as the grain offering of your firstfruits.
verses.2:15: Then you shall put oil on it and place frankincense on it; it is a grain offering.
verses.2:16: And the priest shall turn its memorial portion into smoke, part of its crushed grain and part of its oil, along with all its frankincense, a fire offering to the LORD."
verses.3:1: "Now if his offering is a sacrifice of peace offerings, if he is presenting from the herd, whether male or female, he shall present it unblemished before the LORD.
verses.3:2: He shall press his hand on the head of his offering and slaughter it at the entrance of the tent of meeting, and the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall dash the blood against the altar all around.
verses.3:3: And he shall present from the sacrifice of peace offerings a fire offering to the LORD: the fat that covers the inner parts and all the fat that is on the inner parts,
verses.3:4: and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the lobe on the liver; he shall remove it along with the kidneys.
verses.3:5: Then the sons of Aaron shall turn it into smoke on the altar, on top of the burnt offering that is on the wood that is on the fire, a fire offering of a soothing fragrance to the LORD.
verses.3:6: Now if his offering for a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD is from the flock, male or female, he shall present it unblemished.
verses.3:7: If he is presenting a lamb as his offering, then he shall present it before the LORD.
verses.3:8: He shall press his hand on the head of his offering and slaughter it before the tent of meeting, and the sons of Aaron shall dash its blood against the altar all around.
verses.3:9: Then from the sacrifice of peace offerings he shall present a fire offering to the LORD: its fat, the whole fat tail, which he shall remove close beside the backbone, and the fat that covers the inner parts and all the fat that is on the inner parts,
verses.3:10: and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the lobe on the liver; he shall remove it along with the kidneys.
verses.3:11: And the priest shall turn it into smoke on the altar, food of a fire offering to the LORD.
verses.3:12: And if his offering is a goat, then he shall present it before the LORD.
verses.3:13: He shall press his hand on its head and slaughter it before the tent of meeting, and the sons of Aaron shall dash its blood against the altar all around.
verses.3:14: Then from it he shall present his offering, a fire offering to the LORD: the fat that covers the inner parts and all the fat that is on the inner parts,
verses.3:15: and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the lobe on the liver; he shall remove it along with the kidneys.
verses.3:16: And the priest shall turn them into smoke on the altar, food of a fire offering for a soothing fragrance; all fat belongs to the LORD.
verses.3:17: It is a permanent statute for your generations in all your dwelling places: you shall eat no fat and no blood."
verses.4:1: Now the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.4:2: "Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, 'When a person sins inadvertently against any of the commandments of the LORD regarding things that must not be done, and does any one of them:
verses.4:3: if the anointed priest sins, bringing guilt on the people, then for his sin that he has sinned he shall present an unblemished bull from the herd to the LORD as a sin offering.
verses.4:4: He shall bring the bull to the entrance of the tent of meeting before the LORD, press his hand on the head of the bull, and slaughter the bull before the LORD.
verses.4:5: Then the anointed priest shall take some of the blood of the bull and bring it into the tent of meeting.
verses.4:6: The priest shall dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle some of the blood seven times before the LORD, in front of the curtain of the sanctuary.
verses.4:7: The priest shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of fragrant incense before the LORD, which is in the tent of meeting, and he shall pour out all the blood of the bull at the base of the altar of burnt offering that is at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
verses.4:8: All the fat of the bull of the sin offering he shall lift off from it: the fat that covers the inner parts and all the fat that is on the inner parts,
verses.4:9: and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them, which is at the loins, and the lobe on the liver, which he shall remove along with the kidneys,
verses.4:10: just as it is lifted off from the ox of the sacrifice of peace offerings. Then the priest shall turn them into smoke on the altar of burnt offering.
verses.4:11: But the hide of the bull and all its flesh, along with its head and its legs, its inner parts and its dung,
verses.4:12: the entire bull he shall carry outside the camp to a clean place, to where the fatty ashes are poured out, and burn it on wood in the fire; on the place where the fatty ashes are poured out it shall be burned.
verses.4:13: Now if the whole congregation of Israel errs inadvertently, and a matter is hidden from the eyes of the assembly, and they do any one of all the commandments of the LORD regarding things that must not be done, and become guilty,
verses.4:14: when the sin regarding which they have sinned becomes known, then the assembly shall present a bull from the herd as a sin offering and bring it before the tent of meeting.
verses.4:15: The elders of the congregation shall press their hands on the head of the bull before the LORD, and one shall slaughter the bull before the LORD.
verses.4:16: Then the anointed priest shall bring some of the blood of the bull into the tent of meeting.
verses.4:17: The priest shall dip his finger in some of the blood and sprinkle it seven times before the LORD, in front of the curtain.
verses.4:18: He shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar that is before the LORD, which is in the tent of meeting, and all the blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering that is at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
verses.4:19: All its fat he shall lift off from it and turn it into smoke on the altar.
verses.4:20: He shall do with the bull just as he did with the bull of the sin offering; so shall he do with it. Thus the priest shall make atonement for them, and they will be forgiven.
verses.4:21: Then he shall carry the bull outside the camp and burn it just as he burned the first bull; it is the sin offering of the assembly.
verses.4:22: When a leader sins and inadvertently does any one of all the commandments of the LORD his God regarding things that must not be done, and becomes guilty,
verses.4:23: or if his sin in which he has sinned is made known to him, then he shall bring his offering, a goat, an unblemished male.
verses.4:24: He shall press his hand on the head of the male goat and slaughter it in the place where one slaughters the burnt offering before the LORD; it is a sin offering.
verses.4:25: Then the priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and he shall pour out its blood at the base of the altar of burnt offering.
verses.4:26: All its fat he shall turn into smoke on the altar, like the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings. Thus the priest shall make atonement for him on account of his sin, and he will be forgiven.
verses.4:27: Now if one person from the people of the land sins inadvertently, by doing one of the commandments of the LORD regarding things that must not be done, and becomes guilty,
verses.4:28: or if his sin that he has sinned is made known to him, then he shall bring his offering, a goat, an unblemished female, for his sin that he has sinned.
verses.4:29: He shall press his hand on the head of the sin offering and slaughter the sin offering in the place of the burnt offering.
verses.4:30: Then the priest shall take some of its blood with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and he shall pour out all its blood at the base of the altar.
verses.4:31: All its fat he shall remove, just as the fat is removed from the sacrifice of peace offerings, and the priest shall turn it into smoke on the altar for a soothing fragrance to the LORD. Thus the priest shall make atonement for him, and he will be forgiven.
verses.4:32: And if he brings a lamb as his offering for a sin offering, he shall bring an unblemished female.
verses.4:33: He shall press his hand on the head of the sin offering and slaughter it as a sin offering in the place where one slaughters the burnt offering.
verses.4:34: Then the priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and he shall pour out all its blood at the base of the altar.
verses.4:35: All its fat he shall remove, just as the fat of the lamb is removed from the sacrifice of peace offerings, and the priest shall turn them into smoke on the altar, upon the fire offerings of the LORD. Thus the priest shall make atonement for him for his sin that he has sinned, and he will be forgiven.'"
verses.5:1: "'Now if a person sins and hears the voice of an adjuration, and he is a witness, whether he has seen or has known, if he does not report it, then he shall bear his iniquity.
verses.5:2: Or if a person touches any unclean thing, whether the carcass of an unclean wild animal, or the carcass of an unclean domestic animal, or the carcass of an unclean swarming creature, and it is hidden from him, yet he is unclean and becomes guilty;
verses.5:3: or if he touches human uncleanness, whatever his uncleanness may be by which he becomes unclean, and it is hidden from him, yet he comes to know it and becomes guilty;
verses.5:4: or if a person swears, uttering rashly with the lips to do harm or to do good, in whatever a person may utter rashly in an oath, and it is hidden from him, yet he comes to know it and becomes guilty in one of these.
verses.5:5: So it shall be, when he becomes guilty in one of these, that he shall confess that concerning which he has sinned.
verses.5:6: And he shall bring to the LORD his guilt offering for his sin that he has sinned, a female from the flock, a female lamb or a female goat, as a sin offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him on account of his sin.
verses.5:7: But if his hand does not reach enough for a lamb, then he shall bring to the LORD, as his guilt offering for that which he has sinned, two turtledoves or two young pigeons, one as a sin offering and one as a burnt offering.
verses.5:8: He shall bring them to the priest, who shall present the one for the sin offering first, and wring its head at the back of its neck, yet he shall not sever it.
verses.5:9: He shall sprinkle some of the blood of the sin offering on the side of the altar, while the remainder of the blood shall be drained out at the base of the altar; it is a sin offering.
verses.5:10: The second he shall prepare as a burnt offering according to the ordinance. Thus the priest shall make atonement for him on account of his sin that he has sinned, and he will be forgiven.
verses.5:11: But if his hand cannot reach two turtledoves or two young pigeons, then he shall bring as his offering for that which he has sinned a tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a sin offering; he shall not put oil on it, nor place frankincense on it, for it is a sin offering.
verses.5:12: He shall bring it to the priest, and the priest shall scoop from it a full handful as its memorial portion and turn it into smoke on the altar, upon the fire offerings of the LORD; it is a sin offering.
verses.5:13: Thus the priest shall make atonement for him for his sin that he has sinned in any one of these, and he will be forgiven. And it shall belong to the priest, like the grain offering.'"
verses.5:14: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.5:15: "If a person commits an act of unfaithfulness and sins inadvertently concerning the holy things of the LORD, then he shall bring his guilt offering to the LORD: an unblemished ram from the flock, according to your valuation in silver shekels, by the shekel of the sanctuary, as a guilt offering.
verses.5:16: He shall make restitution for what he has sinned against the holy thing, and shall add a fifth to it and give it to the priest. Then the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the guilt offering, and he will be forgiven.
verses.5:17: Now if a person sins and does any one of all the commandments of the LORD regarding things that must not be done, though he does not know it, yet he becomes guilty and shall bear his iniquity.
verses.5:18: He shall bring an unblemished ram from the flock, according to your valuation, as a guilt offering to the priest. Then the priest shall make atonement for him for his inadvertent error in which he erred though he did not know it, and he will be forgiven.
verses.5:19: It is a guilt offering; he has surely become guilty before the LORD."
verses.5:20: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.5:21: "If a person sins and commits an act of unfaithfulness against the LORD, and lies to his neighbor regarding a deposit, or a security, or robbery, or extorts from his neighbor,
verses.5:22: or finds lost property and lies about it, and swears falsely concerning any one of all the things that a person may do, sinning in them,
verses.5:23: then it shall be, when he has sinned and become guilty, that he shall restore what he took by robbery, or what he obtained by extortion, or the deposit that was deposited with him, or the lost property that he found,
verses.5:24: or anything about which he swore falsely; he shall make restitution for it in full and add a fifth to it, and give it to the one to whom it belongs on the day of his guilt.
verses.5:25: Then he shall bring his guilt offering to the LORD: an unblemished ram from the flock, according to your valuation, as a guilt offering to the priest.
verses.5:26: And the priest shall make atonement for him before the LORD, and he will be forgiven for any one of all the things that he may do so as to become guilty in it."
verses.6:1: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.6:2: "Command Aaron and his sons, saying, 'This is the law of the burnt offering: the burnt offering itself shall remain on the hearth upon the altar all night until the morning, and the fire of the altar shall be kept burning on it.
verses.6:3: And the priest shall put on his linen garment, and he shall put linen undergarments over his flesh; then he shall take up the ashes into which the fire consumes the burnt offering on the altar, and set them beside the altar.
verses.6:4: And he shall remove his garments, put on other garments, and bring the ashes outside the camp to a clean place.
verses.6:5: And the fire on the altar shall be kept burning on it; it shall not go out. The priest shall burn wood on it morning by morning, arrange the burnt offering on it, and turn the fat portions of the peace offerings into smoke on it.
verses.6:6: A continual fire shall be kept burning on the altar; it shall not go out.
verses.6:7: And this is the law of the grain offering: the sons of Aaron shall present it before the LORD, at the front of the altar.
verses.6:8: And he shall take up from it a handful of the fine flour of the grain offering and of its oil, together with all the frankincense that is on the grain offering, and turn its memorial portion into smoke on the altar, a soothing fragrance to the LORD.
verses.6:9: And what remains of it Aaron and his sons shall eat; it shall be eaten unleavened in a holy place; in the courtyard of the tent of meeting they shall eat it.
verses.6:10: It shall not be baked with leaven. As their portion I have given it from My fire offerings; it is most holy, like the sin offering and like the guilt offering.
verses.6:11: Every male among the sons of Aaron may eat it; it is a permanent statute throughout your generations from the fire offerings of the LORD. Whatever touches them shall become holy.'"
verses.6:12: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.6:13: "This is the offering of Aaron and his sons which they shall present to the LORD on the day he is anointed: a tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a continual grain offering, half of it in the morning and half of it in the evening.
verses.6:14: It shall be prepared with oil on a griddle; you shall bring it well stirred. You shall present the baked portions of a grain offering of pieces as a soothing fragrance to the LORD.
verses.6:15: And the anointed priest in his place from among his sons shall prepare it; by a permanent statute, it shall be wholly turned into smoke to the LORD.
verses.6:16: And every grain offering of a priest shall be a whole offering; it shall not be eaten."
verses.6:17: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.6:18: "Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, 'This is the law of the sin offering: at the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered, the sin offering shall be slaughtered before the LORD; it is most holy.
verses.6:19: The priest who offers it as a sin offering shall eat it; it shall be eaten in a holy place, in the courtyard of the tent of meeting.
verses.6:20: Whatever touches its flesh shall become holy; and when any of its blood spatters onto a garment, you shall wash that on which it spattered in a holy place.
verses.6:21: And an earthenware vessel in which it is boiled shall be broken; but if it was boiled in a bronze vessel, it shall be scoured and rinsed with water.
verses.6:22: Every male among the priests may eat it; it is most holy.
verses.6:23: And no sin offering any of whose blood is brought into the tent of meeting to make atonement in the sanctuary shall be eaten; it shall be burned in the fire.'"
verses.7:1: And this is the law of the guilt offering: it is most holy.
verses.7:2: At the place where they slaughter the burnt offering, they shall slaughter the guilt offering, and he shall dash its blood against the altar all around.
verses.7:3: And he shall present all its fat from it: the fat tail and the fat that covers the inner parts,
verses.7:4: and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them, which is at the loins; and he shall remove the lobe on the liver along with the kidneys.
verses.7:5: And the priest shall turn them into smoke on the altar as a fire offering to the LORD; it is a guilt offering.
verses.7:6: Every male among the priests may eat it. It shall be eaten in a holy place; it is most holy.
verses.7:7: As the sin offering is, so is the guilt offering; there is one law for them: it shall belong to the priest who makes atonement with it.
verses.7:8: And as for the priest who presents any man's burnt offering, the hide of the burnt offering which he presented shall belong to that priest himself.
verses.7:9: And every grain offering that is baked in an oven, and all that is made in a deep pan or on a griddle, shall belong to the priest who presents it.
verses.7:10: And every grain offering, whether mixed with oil or dry, shall belong to all the sons of Aaron, each one like his brother.
verses.7:11: And this is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings which one presents to the LORD:
verses.7:12: If he presents it for thanksgiving, then along with the sacrifice of thanksgiving he shall present unleavened cakes mixed with oil, unleavened wafers brushed with oil, and cakes of well-stirred fine flour mixed with oil.
verses.7:13: Along with cakes of leavened bread he shall present his offering, together with the thanksgiving sacrifice of his peace offerings.
verses.7:14: And from it he shall present one out of each offering as a contribution to the LORD; it shall belong to the priest who dashes the blood of the peace offerings.
verses.7:15: And the flesh of the thanksgiving sacrifice of his peace offerings shall be eaten on the day of his offering; he shall not leave any of it until morning.
verses.7:16: But if the sacrifice of his offering is a vow or a freewill offering, it shall be eaten on the day he presents his sacrifice, and on the next day what remains of it may also be eaten.
verses.7:17: Yet what remains of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burned in the fire.
verses.7:18: And if any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings is eaten at all on the third day, it shall not be accepted; it shall not be credited to the one who presents it. It shall be a foul thing, and the person who eats of it shall bear his iniquity.
verses.7:19: And the flesh that touches anything unclean shall not be eaten; it shall be burned in the fire. And as for the flesh, everyone who is clean may eat flesh.
verses.7:20: But the person who eats flesh from the sacrifice of peace offerings that belongs to the LORD while his uncleanness is upon him, that person shall be cut off from his people.
verses.7:21: And when a person touches anything unclean, whether human uncleanness, or an unclean animal, or any unclean detestable thing, and eats of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings that belongs to the LORD, that person shall be cut off from his people.
verses.7:22: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.7:23: "Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, 'You shall not eat any fat of ox, sheep, or goat.
verses.7:24: And the fat of an animal that dies naturally and the fat of one torn to pieces may be used for any work, but you shall not eat it at all.
verses.7:25: For whoever eats fat from an animal from which one presents a fire offering to the LORD, the person who eats it shall be cut off from his people.
verses.7:26: And you shall not eat any blood in any of your dwelling places, whether of bird or of animal.
verses.7:27: Every person who eats any blood, that person shall be cut off from his people.'"
verses.7:28: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.7:29: "Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, 'The one who presents the sacrifice of his peace offerings to the LORD shall bring his offering to the LORD from the sacrifice of his peace offerings.
verses.7:30: His own hands shall bring the fire offerings of the LORD; he shall bring the fat with the breast, so as to wave the breast as a wave offering before the LORD.
verses.7:31: And the priest shall turn the fat into smoke on the altar, but the breast shall belong to Aaron and to his sons.
verses.7:32: And you shall give the right thigh to the priest as a contribution from the sacrifices of your peace offerings.
verses.7:33: For the one among the sons of Aaron who presents the blood of the peace offerings and the fat, the right thigh shall be his as a portion.
verses.7:34: For I have taken the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the contribution from the sons of Israel, from the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and I have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons as a permanent statute from the sons of Israel.'"
verses.7:35: This is the anointing portion of Aaron and the anointing portion of his sons from the fire offerings of the LORD, on the day they were presented to serve as priests to the LORD,
verses.7:36: which the LORD commanded to be given to them from the sons of Israel on the day He anointed them, a permanent statute throughout their generations.
verses.7:37: This is the law for the burnt offering, for the grain offering, for the sin offering, for the guilt offering, for the ordination, and for the sacrifice of peace offerings,
verses.7:38: which the LORD commanded Moses on Mount Sinai, on the day He commanded the sons of Israel to present their offerings to the LORD in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.8:1: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.8:2: "Take Aaron and his sons with him, along with the garments, the anointing oil, the bull for the sin offering, the two rams, and the basket of unleavened bread,
verses.8:3: and assemble the entire congregation at the entrance of the tent of meeting."
verses.8:4: Moses did just as the LORD commanded him, and the congregation assembled at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
verses.8:5: Then Moses said to the congregation, "This is the matter the LORD has commanded to be done."
verses.8:6: Then Moses brought Aaron and his sons forward and washed them with water.
verses.8:7: He put the tunic on him, wrapped the sash around him, clothed him with the robe, and put the ephod on him; then he wrapped the woven band of the ephod around him and secured the ephod onto him with it.
verses.8:8: Then he set the breastpiece on him and put the Urim and the Thummim into the breastpiece.
verses.8:9: He set the turban on his head, and on the turban, at the front, he set the gold plate, the sacred diadem, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.8:10: Moses took the anointing oil, anointed the tabernacle and everything that was in it, and consecrated them.
verses.8:11: He sprinkled some of it onto the altar seven times, and he anointed the altar and all its implements, along with the basin and its base, to consecrate them.
verses.8:12: Next he poured some of the anointing oil onto Aaron's head and anointed him to consecrate him.
verses.8:13: Then Moses brought Aaron's sons forward, clothed them with tunics, wrapped sashes around them, and bound caps on them, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.8:14: Then he led forward the bull for the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons pressed their hands on the head of the bull for the sin offering.
verses.8:15: He slaughtered it, and Moses took the blood and put it with his finger on the horns of the altar all around, and purified the altar; then he poured out the blood at the base of the altar and consecrated it to make atonement for it.
verses.8:16: He took all the fat that was on the inner parts, the lobe of the liver, and the two kidneys and their fat, and Moses turned them into smoke on the altar.
verses.8:17: But the bull, along with its hide, its flesh, and its dung, he burned with fire outside the camp, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.8:18: Then he presented the ram for the burnt offering, and Aaron and his sons pressed their hands on the head of the ram.
verses.8:19: He slaughtered it, and Moses dashed the blood against the altar all around.
verses.8:20: He cut the ram into its pieces, and Moses turned the head, the pieces, and the suet into smoke.
verses.8:21: He washed the inner parts and the legs with water, and Moses turned the entire ram into smoke on the altar. It was a burnt offering for a soothing fragrance; it was a fire offering to the LORD, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.8:22: Then he presented the second ram, the ram of ordination, and Aaron and his sons pressed their hands on the head of the ram.
verses.8:23: He slaughtered it, and Moses took some of its blood and placed it on the lobe of Aaron's right ear, on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.
verses.8:24: Next he brought Aaron's sons forward, and Moses placed some of the blood on the lobes of their right ears, on the thumbs of their right hands, and on the big toes of their right feet; then Moses dashed the blood against the altar all around.
verses.8:25: He took the fat, the fat tail, all the fat that was on the inner parts, the lobe of the liver, the two kidneys along with their fat, and the right thigh.
verses.8:26: And from the basket of unleavened bread that was before the LORD, he took one unleavened cake, one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and set them upon the fat portions and upon the right thigh.
verses.8:27: He placed all of them upon the palms of Aaron and upon the palms of his sons, and he waved them as a wave offering before the LORD.
verses.8:28: Then Moses took them off their palms and turned them into smoke on the altar, on top of the burnt offering. They were an ordination offering for a soothing fragrance; it was a fire offering to the LORD.
verses.8:29: Moses took the breast and waved it as a wave offering before the LORD; from the ram of ordination it became Moses' portion, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.8:30: Then Moses took some of the anointing oil and some of the blood that was on the altar, and sprinkled it upon Aaron, upon his garments, upon his sons, and upon the garments of his sons with him; thus he consecrated Aaron, his garments, his sons, and the garments of his sons with him.
verses.8:31: Then Moses said to Aaron and to his sons, "Boil the flesh at the entrance of the tent of meeting, and there you shall eat it, together with the bread that is in the basket of ordination, just as I commanded, saying, 'Aaron and his sons are to eat it.'
verses.8:32: What is left over from the flesh and from the bread you shall burn with fire.
verses.8:33: You shall not go out from the entrance of the tent of meeting for seven days, until the day the days of your ordination are fulfilled, because for seven days you will be ordained.
verses.8:34: Just as has been done on this day, so the LORD has commanded to be done to make atonement for you.
verses.8:35: You shall stay at the entrance of the tent of meeting day and night for seven days and keep the LORD's charge, so that you will not die; for so I have been commanded."
verses.8:36: So Aaron and his sons did all the things that the LORD had commanded by the hand of Moses.
verses.9:1: Now on the eighth day, Moses summoned Aaron and his sons and the elders of Israel.
verses.9:2: He said to Aaron, "Take for yourself a calf from the herd for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering, unblemished, and present them before the LORD.
verses.9:3: And you shall speak to the sons of Israel, saying, 'Take a male goat for a sin offering, and a calf and a lamb, a year old and unblemished, for a burnt offering,
verses.9:4: as well as an ox and a ram for peace offerings to sacrifice before the LORD, and a grain offering blended with oil, because today the LORD will appear to you.'"
verses.9:5: They took what Moses had commanded to the front of the tent of meeting, and the entire congregation approached and stood before the LORD.
verses.9:6: Then Moses said, "This is the matter the LORD has commanded you to do, so that the glory of the LORD may appear to you."
verses.9:7: Then Moses said to Aaron, "Approach the altar, offer your sin offering and your burnt offering, and make atonement for yourself and for the people; then offer the people's offering and make atonement for them, just as the LORD has commanded."
verses.9:8: So Aaron approached the altar and slaughtered the calf for the sin offering that was for himself.
verses.9:9: The sons of Aaron presented the blood to him; he dipped his finger into the blood and placed it on the horns of the altar, and he poured the blood out at the base of the altar.
verses.9:10: But the fat, the kidneys, and the lobe from the liver, from the sin offering, he turned into smoke on the altar, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.9:11: And the flesh and the hide he burned with fire outside the camp.
verses.9:12: Then he slaughtered the burnt offering; Aaron's sons delivered the blood to him, and he dashed it against the altar all around.
verses.9:13: They also delivered the burnt offering to him in its pieces, along with the head, and he turned them into smoke on the altar.
verses.9:14: He washed the inner parts and the legs and turned them into smoke on top of the burnt offering on the altar.
verses.9:15: Next he presented the people's offering; he took the male goat for the sin offering that was for the people, slaughtered it, and offered it as a sin offering, just like the first.
verses.9:16: Then he presented the burnt offering and offered it according to the ordinance.
verses.9:17: He presented the grain offering, filled his palm with some of it, and turned it into smoke on the altar, in addition to the morning burnt offering.
verses.9:18: Then he slaughtered the ox and the ram, the sacrifice of peace offerings that was for the people. Aaron's sons delivered the blood to him, and he dashed it against the altar all around.
verses.9:19: And the fat portions from the ox and from the ram—the fat tail, the covering fat, the kidneys, and the lobe of the liver—
verses.9:20: they set the fat portions on the breasts, and he turned the fat portions into smoke on the altar.
verses.9:21: As for the breasts and the right thigh, Aaron waved them as a wave offering before the LORD, just as Moses had commanded.
verses.9:22: Then Aaron raised his hands toward the people and blessed them, and he came down from offering the sin offering, the burnt offering, and the peace offerings.
verses.9:23: Moses and Aaron entered the tent of meeting, then came out and blessed the people; and the glory of the LORD appeared to all the people.
verses.9:24: Fire came out from before the LORD and consumed the burnt offering and the fat portions on the altar. All the people saw it, shouted for joy, and fell on their faces.
verses.10:1: Aaron's sons, Nadab and Abihu, each took his firepan, placed fire inside them, laid incense over it, and presented strange fire before the LORD, which He had not commanded them.
verses.10:2: Fire then went out from before the LORD and devoured them, and they died before the LORD.
verses.10:3: Moses told Aaron, "This is what the LORD declared, saying, 'Through those who are near Me I will be treated as holy, and before all the people I will be honored.'" And Aaron remained silent.
verses.10:4: Moses called to Mishael and Elzaphan, sons of Uzziel, Aaron's uncle, and said to them, "Come near, carry your kinsmen away from the front of the sanctuary to outside the camp."
verses.10:5: So they came near and carried them in their tunics to outside the camp, just as Moses had spoken.
verses.10:6: Moses then said to Aaron and to his sons Eleazar and Ithamar, "Do not let the hair of your heads hang loose, and do not tear your garments, so that you will not die and He will not grow wrathful against the entire congregation; rather, your kinsmen, the entire house of Israel, will weep over the burning that the LORD has kindled.
verses.10:7: And do not go out from the entrance of the tent of meeting, or else you will die, because the anointing oil of the LORD is upon you." So they acted according to the word of Moses.
verses.10:8: Then the LORD spoke to Aaron, saying,
verses.10:9: "Drink neither wine nor fermented drink, you or your sons with you, when you enter the tent of meeting, so that you do not die; this is a permanent statute throughout your generations,
verses.10:10: so that you may distinguish between what is holy and what is common, and between what is unclean and what is clean,
verses.10:11: and instruct the sons of Israel in all the statutes that the LORD spoke to them by the hand of Moses."
verses.10:12: Then Moses spoke to Aaron and to his remaining sons, Eleazar and Ithamar: "Take the grain offering remaining from the fire offerings of the LORD and eat it unleavened beside the altar, because it is most holy.
verses.10:13: You must eat it in a holy place, because it is your allotted portion and your sons' allotted portion from the fire offerings of the LORD, for that is how I was commanded.
verses.10:14: As for the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the contribution, you may eat them in a clean place—you, your sons, and your daughters with you—because they have been given as your allotted portion and your sons' allotted portion from the peace-offering sacrifices of the sons of Israel.
verses.10:15: The thigh of the contribution and the breast of the wave offering they must bring along with the fire offerings of the fat portions, to wave as a wave offering before the LORD; and it will belong to you and to your sons with you as a lasting allotment, just as the LORD has commanded."
verses.10:16: Then Moses diligently inquired about the male goat of the sin offering, and look, it had been burned up. So he grew wrathful against Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron's remaining sons, saying,
verses.10:17: "Why did you not eat the sin offering in the place of the sanctuary, since it is most holy and He gave it to you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before the LORD?
verses.10:18: Look, its blood was not brought inside the sanctuary; you certainly should have eaten it in the sanctuary, just as I commanded."
verses.10:19: Then Aaron spoke to Moses, "Look, today they presented their sin offering and their burnt offering before the LORD, and yet things like these have happened to me. If I had eaten a sin offering today, would that have been good in the eyes of the LORD?"
verses.10:20: Moses heard this, and it was good in his eyes.
verses.11:1: Then the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying to them,
verses.11:2: "Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, 'These are the living creatures that you may eat from among all the beasts that are upon the earth:
verses.11:3: Any among the beasts that has a divided hoof, cleaving a split completely through the hooves, and brings up the cud—that you may eat.
verses.11:4: However, these you must not eat from among those that bring up the cud or those that divide the hoof: the camel, because it brings up the cud yet does not divide the hoof—it is unclean for you;
verses.11:5: and the rock hyrax, because it brings up the cud yet does not divide the hoof—it is unclean for you;
verses.11:6: and the hare, because it brings up the cud yet does not divide the hoof—it is unclean for you;
verses.11:7: and the pig, because it divides the hoof and cleaves a split completely through the hoof, yet it does not chew the cud—it is unclean for you.
verses.11:8: You must not eat any of their flesh, nor touch their carcass; they are unclean for you.
verses.11:9: These you may eat from everything that is in the water: anything in the water, in the seas or in the streams, that has fins and scales—those you may eat.
verses.11:10: But everything in the seas and in the streams that lacks fins and scales, out of all the swarming creatures of the water and every living creature in the water—they are abhorrent to you.
verses.11:11: Abhorrent they must remain to you; you must not eat any of their flesh, and you must regard their carcass as abhorrent.
verses.11:12: Everything in the water that lacks fins and scales is abhorrent to you.
verses.11:13: And among the birds, these you must regard as abhorrent; they are not to be eaten, they are abhorrent: the eagle, the bearded vulture, and the black vulture,
verses.11:14: the kite, and the falcon according to its kind,
verses.11:15: every raven according to its kind,
verses.11:16: the ostrich, the nighthawk, the seagull, and the hawk according to its kind,
verses.11:17: the little owl, the cormorant, and the great owl,
verses.11:18: the barn owl, the desert owl, and the carrion vulture,
verses.11:19: the stork, the heron according to its kind, the hoopoe, and the bat.
verses.11:20: Every winged swarming creature that walks on all fours is abhorrent to you.
verses.11:21: However, these you may eat from among all winged swarming creatures that walk on all fours: those that have jointed legs above their feet for leaping upon the earth.
verses.11:22: Of them, you may eat these: the locust according to its kind, the bald locust according to its kind, the cricket according to its kind, and the grasshopper according to its kind.
verses.11:23: But every winged swarming creature that has four feet is abhorrent to you.
verses.11:24: And through these you will become unclean: anyone touching their carcass will be unclean until evening,
verses.11:25: and anyone carrying any part of their carcass must wash his garments and remain unclean until evening.
verses.11:26: Regarding every beast that divides the hoof yet does not cleave a split through it, and does not bring up the cud—they are unclean for you; anyone touching them will become unclean.
verses.11:27: And everything walking on its paws among all the living creatures that walk on all fours—they are unclean for you; anyone touching their carcass will be unclean until evening,
verses.11:28: and the one carrying their carcass must wash his garments and remain unclean until evening; they are unclean for you.
verses.11:29: Now these are what are unclean for you among the swarming creatures that swarm upon the earth: the mole rat, the mouse, and the great lizard according to its kind,
verses.11:30: the gecko, the monitor lizard, the wall lizard, the skink, and the chameleon.
verses.11:31: These are the unclean ones for you among all the swarming creatures; anyone touching them once they are dead will be unclean until evening.
verses.11:32: Furthermore, anything on which one of them falls when they are dead will become unclean—whether any wooden item, garment, leather, or sackcloth, any article with which work is performed; it must be put into water and remain unclean until evening, and then it will be clean.
verses.11:33: And if one of them falls inside any clay vessel, everything inside it will become unclean, and the vessel itself you must break.
verses.11:34: Any food that may be eaten on which water comes will become unclean, and any drink that may be drunk in any vessel will become unclean.
verses.11:35: Everything on which any part of their carcass falls will become unclean; an oven or a cooking stove must be broken down—they are unclean, and unclean they will remain for you.
verses.11:36: Yet a spring or a cistern, a gathering of water, will remain clean, though anyone touching their carcass will become unclean.
verses.11:37: And if any part of their carcass falls on any sowing seed that is to be sown, it remains clean.
verses.11:38: But if water has been put on seed and any part of their carcass falls on it, it is unclean for you.
verses.11:39: Now if one of the beasts that is for you to eat dies, the one touching its carcass will be unclean until evening.
verses.11:40: The one eating any of its carcass must wash his garments and remain unclean until evening, and the one carrying its carcass must wash his garments and remain unclean until evening.
verses.11:41: Now every swarming creature that swarms upon the earth is abhorrent; it must not be eaten.
verses.11:42: Everything that goes on its belly, and everything that walks on all fours, even up to everything with many feet among all the swarming creatures that swarm upon the earth—you must not eat them, because they are abhorrent.
verses.11:43: Do not make yourselves abhorrent through any swarming creature that swarms, and do not make yourselves unclean by them so that you become defiled by them.
verses.11:44: Because I am the LORD your God, sanctify yourselves and become holy, since I am holy; and do not make yourselves unclean through any swarming creature that creeps upon the earth.
verses.11:45: Because I am the LORD, the One bringing you up out of the land of Egypt to be God to you; so you must be holy, because I am holy.
verses.11:46: This is the law concerning the beasts, the birds, every living creature that moves in the water, and every creature that swarms upon the earth,
verses.11:47: to distinguish between what is unclean and what is clean, and between the living creature that may be eaten and the living creature that must not be eaten.'"
verses.12:1: Now the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.12:2: "Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, 'When a woman conceives and gives birth to a male, she will be unclean for seven days; just as during the days of the impurity of her menstrual illness, she will be unclean.
verses.12:3: And on the eighth day, the flesh of his foreskin must be circumcised.
verses.12:4: And for thirty-three days she will remain in the blood of purification; she must not touch anything holy, and she must not enter the sanctuary until the completion of the days of her purification.
verses.12:5: But if she gives birth to a female, she will be unclean for two weeks, as during her menstrual impurity; and for sixty-six days she will remain in the blood of purification.
verses.12:6: And at the completion of the days of her purification, for a son or for a daughter, she must bring a lamb in its first year as a burnt offering and a young pigeon or a turtledove as a sin offering to the entrance of the tent of meeting, to the priest.
verses.12:7: And he will present it before the LORD and make atonement on her behalf, and she will become clean from the source of her blood. This is the law concerning the woman who gives birth, for a male or for a female.
verses.12:8: But if her hand does not reach enough for a sheep, she must take two turtledoves or two young pigeons, one as a burnt offering and one as a sin offering; and the priest will make atonement on her behalf, and she will become clean.'"
verses.13:1: And the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.13:2: "When a person has a swelling, a rash, or a bright spot on the skin of his flesh, and it becomes an affliction of leprosy on the skin of his flesh, he shall be brought to Aaron the priest or to one of his sons, the priests.
verses.13:3: The priest shall examine the affliction on the skin of the flesh; if hair in the affliction has turned white and the appearance of the affliction is deeper than the skin of his flesh, it is an affliction of leprosy. When the priest examines him, he shall declare him unclean.
verses.13:4: But if it is a white bright spot on the skin of his flesh, and its appearance is not deeper than the skin, and its hair has not turned white, then the priest shall confine the afflicted person for seven days.
verses.13:5: The priest shall examine him on the seventh day, and look, the affliction has stayed unchanged in his sight, the affliction has not spread on the skin; then the priest shall confine him for seven days a second time.
verses.13:6: Then the priest shall examine him on the seventh day a second time, and look, the affliction has faded and the affliction has not spread on the skin; then the priest shall declare him clean. It is a rash; he shall wash his garments and be clean.
verses.13:7: But if the rash indeed spreads on the skin after he has shown himself to the priest for his cleansing, he shall show himself to the priest a second time.
verses.13:8: The priest shall examine him, and look, the rash has spread on the skin; then the priest shall declare him unclean. It is leprosy.
verses.13:9: When an affliction of leprosy is on a person, he shall be brought to the priest.
verses.13:10: The priest shall examine him, and look, there is a white swelling on the skin, and it has turned hair white, and there is a patch of raw flesh in the swelling.
verses.13:11: It is chronic leprosy on the skin of his flesh, and the priest shall declare him unclean. He shall not confine him, for he is unclean.
verses.13:12: And if the leprosy indeed breaks out on the skin, and the leprosy covers all the skin of the afflicted person, from his head to his feet, as far as the priest's eyes can see,
verses.13:13: then the priest shall examine him, and look, the leprosy has covered all his flesh; then he shall declare the afflicted person clean. All of him has turned white; he is clean.
verses.13:14: But on the day raw flesh appears on him, he shall be unclean.
verses.13:15: The priest shall examine the raw flesh and declare him unclean. The raw flesh is unclean; it is leprosy.
verses.13:16: Or if the raw flesh changes back and turns to white, then he shall come to the priest.
verses.13:17: The priest shall examine him, and look, the affliction has turned to white; then the priest shall declare the afflicted person clean. He is clean.
verses.13:18: Now when there is a boil in the flesh, on its skin, and it is healed,
verses.13:19: and in the place of the boil there is a white swelling or a reddish-white bright spot, he shall show himself to the priest.
verses.13:20: The priest shall examine it, and look, its appearance is lower than the skin and its hair has turned white; then the priest shall declare him unclean. It is an affliction of leprosy; it has broken out in the boil.
verses.13:21: But if the priest examines it, and look, there is no white hair in it, and it is not lower than the skin, and it is faded, then the priest shall confine him for seven days.
verses.13:22: And if it indeed spreads on the skin, then the priest shall declare him unclean; it is an affliction.
verses.13:23: But if the bright spot stays in its place and has not spread, it is the scar of the boil, and the priest shall declare him clean.
verses.13:24: Or when there is a burn from fire on the skin of the flesh, and the raw patch of the burn becomes a bright spot, reddish-white or white,
verses.13:25: then the priest shall examine it, and look, hair has turned white in the bright spot and its appearance is deeper than the skin. It is leprosy; it has broken out in the burn. So the priest shall declare him unclean; it is an affliction of leprosy.
verses.13:26: But if the priest examines it, and look, there is no white hair in the bright spot, and it is not lower than the skin, and it is faded, then the priest shall confine him for seven days.
verses.13:27: The priest shall examine him on the seventh day. If it indeed spreads on the skin, then the priest shall declare him unclean; it is an affliction of leprosy.
verses.13:28: But if the bright spot stays in its place, has not spread on the skin, and is faded, it is the swelling of the burn, and the priest shall declare him clean, for it is the scar of the burn.
verses.13:29: Now when a man or a woman has an affliction on the head or on the beard,
verses.13:30: then the priest shall examine the affliction, and look, its appearance is deeper than the skin, and there is fine yellowish hair in it; then the priest shall declare him unclean. It is a scall; it is leprosy of the head or of the beard.
verses.13:31: But if the priest examines the affliction of the scall, and look, its appearance is not deeper than the skin, and there is no black hair in it, then the priest shall confine the one afflicted with the scall for seven days.
verses.13:32: The priest shall examine the affliction on the seventh day, and look, the scall has not spread, and there is no yellowish hair in it, and the appearance of the scall is not deeper than the skin;
verses.13:33: then he shall shave himself, but he shall not shave the scall, and the priest shall confine the person with the scall for seven days a second time.
verses.13:34: Then the priest shall examine the scall on the seventh day, and look, the scall has not spread on the skin and its appearance is not deeper than the skin; then the priest shall declare him clean. He shall wash his garments and be clean.
verses.13:35: But if the scall indeed spreads on the skin after his cleansing,
verses.13:36: then the priest shall examine him, and look, the scall has spread on the skin; the priest need not search for the yellowish hair. He is unclean.
verses.13:37: But if the scall has stayed unchanged in his sight and black hair has grown in it, the scall is healed. He is clean, and the priest shall declare him clean.
verses.13:38: Now when a man or a woman has bright spots on the skin of their flesh, white bright spots,
verses.13:39: then the priest shall examine them, and look, there are faded white bright spots on the skin of their flesh; it is a pale eruption that has broken out on the skin. He is clean.
verses.13:40: Now when a man's head becomes bare of hair, he is bald; he is clean.
verses.13:41: And if his head becomes bare of hair from the border of his face, he is bald at the forehead; he is clean.
verses.13:42: But if there is a reddish-white affliction on the bald head or on the bald forehead, it is leprosy breaking out on his bald head or on his bald forehead.
verses.13:43: Then the priest shall examine him, and look, the swelling of the affliction is reddish-white on his bald head or on his bald forehead, like the appearance of leprosy on the skin of the flesh.
verses.13:44: He is a leprous man; he is unclean. The priest shall surely declare him unclean; his affliction is on his head.
verses.13:45: As for the leprous person who has the affliction, his garments shall be torn, his head shall be left unkempt, he shall cover his upper lip, and he shall call out, 'Unclean, unclean!'
verses.13:46: All the days that the affliction is on him, he shall be unclean. He is unclean; he shall dwell alone; outside the camp shall be his dwelling place.
verses.13:47: Now when a garment has an affliction of leprosy in it, whether in a wool garment or in a linen garment,
verses.13:48: or in warp or in weft of linen and wool, or in leather or in anything made of leather,
verses.13:49: if the affliction is greenish or reddish in the garment or in the leather, or in the warp or in the weft, or in any leather article, it is an affliction of leprosy, and it shall be shown to the priest.
verses.13:50: The priest shall examine the affliction and shut away the afflicted article for seven days.
verses.13:51: He shall examine the affliction on the seventh day. If the affliction has spread in the garment, or in the warp, or in the weft, or in the leather, for whatever use the leather is made, the affliction is a destructive leprosy; it is unclean.
verses.13:52: So he shall burn the garment, or the warp or the weft, in wool or in linen, or any leather article in which the affliction is; for it is a destructive leprosy; it shall be burned in the fire.
verses.13:53: But if the priest examines it, and look, the affliction has not spread in the garment, or in the warp, or in the weft, or in any leather article,
verses.13:54: then the priest shall command that they wash the item in which the affliction is, and he shall shut it away for seven days a second time.
verses.13:55: Then the priest shall examine it after the affliction has been washed, and look, the affliction has not changed its appearance, though the affliction has not spread; it is unclean. You shall burn it in the fire; it is a corrosion, whether on its bare back or on its bare front.
verses.13:56: But if the priest examines it, and look, the affliction has faded after it has been washed, then he shall tear it out of the garment or out of the leather, or out of the warp or out of the weft.
verses.13:57: And if it appears again in the garment, or in the warp, or in the weft, or in any leather article, it is breaking out; you shall burn in the fire the item in which the affliction is.
verses.13:58: But as for the garment, or the warp, or the weft, or any leather article that you wash, if the affliction departs from them, then it shall be washed a second time and be clean.
verses.13:59: This is the law for an affliction of leprosy in a garment of wool or of linen, or in the warp or the weft, or in any leather article, to declare it clean or to declare it unclean."
verses.14:1: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.14:2: "This will be the law for the leprous person on the day of his cleansing: he shall be brought to the priest.
verses.14:3: And the priest shall go outside the camp, and the priest shall inspect him; and look, the affliction of leprosy has been healed in the leprous person.
verses.14:4: Then the priest shall command that two live clean birds, cedar wood, crimson yarn, and hyssop be taken for the one being cleansed.
verses.14:5: And the priest shall command that the one bird be slaughtered into a clay vessel over living water.
verses.14:6: As for the live bird, he shall take it, and the cedar wood, the crimson yarn, and the hyssop, and he shall dip them and the live bird in the blood of the slaughtered bird over the living water.
verses.14:7: And he shall sprinkle seven times on the one being cleansed from the leprosy and declare him clean, and he shall release the live bird over the open field.
verses.14:8: Then the one being cleansed shall wash his garments, shave off all his hair, and bathe in water, and he shall be clean. Afterward he may enter the camp, yet he shall stay outside his tent seven days.
verses.14:9: And on the seventh day he shall shave off all his hair—his head, his beard, and his eyebrows; all his hair he shall shave off. Then he shall wash his garments and bathe his flesh in water, and he shall be clean.
verses.14:10: And on the eighth day he shall take two unblemished male lambs and one unblemished year-old ewe lamb, three tenth-measures of fine flour as a grain offering mixed with oil, and one log of oil.
verses.14:11: Then the priest who performs the cleansing shall present the man being cleansed and these things before the LORD at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
verses.14:12: And the priest shall take the one male lamb and offer it as a guilt offering, together with the log of oil, and he shall wave them as a wave offering before the LORD.
verses.14:13: He shall slaughter the male lamb in the place where one slaughters the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the sacred place; for like the sin offering, the guilt offering belongs to the priest—it is most holy.
verses.14:14: Then the priest shall take some of the blood of the guilt offering, and the priest shall put it on the lobe of the right ear of the one being cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.
verses.14:15: And the priest shall take some from the log of oil and pour it into the priest's own left palm.
verses.14:16: Then the priest shall dip his right finger into some of the oil that is in his left palm, and he shall sprinkle some of the oil with his finger seven times before the LORD.
verses.14:17: From the remainder of the oil that is in his palm, the priest shall put some on the lobe of the right ear of the one being cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot, on top of the blood of the guilt offering.
verses.14:18: And what remains of the oil that is in the priest's palm he shall put on the head of the one being cleansed; so the priest shall make atonement for him before the LORD.
verses.14:19: And the priest shall offer the sin offering, and he shall make atonement for the one being cleansed from his uncleanness; after that he shall slaughter the burnt offering.
verses.14:20: And the priest shall offer up the burnt offering and the grain offering onto the altar; thus the priest shall make atonement for him, and he shall be clean.
verses.14:21: But if he is poor and his means are insufficient, he shall take one male lamb as a guilt offering for a wave offering to make atonement for him, and one tenth-measure of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering, and a log of oil,
verses.14:22: and two turtledoves or two young pigeons, such as are within his means; one shall be a sin offering and the other a burnt offering.
verses.14:23: And he shall bring them on the eighth day for his cleansing to the priest, to the entrance of the tent of meeting, before the LORD.
verses.14:24: Then the priest shall take the male lamb of the guilt offering and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them as a wave offering before the LORD.
verses.14:25: And he shall slaughter the male lamb of the guilt offering, and the priest shall take some of the blood of the guilt offering and put it on the lobe of the right ear of the one being cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.
verses.14:26: And the priest shall pour some of the oil into the priest's own left palm.
verses.14:27: Then with his right finger the priest shall sprinkle some of the oil that is in his left palm seven times before the LORD.
verses.14:28: And the priest shall put some of the oil that is in his palm on the lobe of the right ear of the one being cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot, on the place of the blood of the guilt offering.
verses.14:29: And what remains of the oil that is in the priest's palm he shall put on the head of the one being cleansed, to make atonement for him before the LORD.
verses.14:30: Then he shall offer one of the turtledoves or of the young pigeons, from what is within his means,
verses.14:31: even what is within his means—the one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering, together with the grain offering; and the priest shall make atonement for the one being cleansed before the LORD.
verses.14:32: This is the law for the one who has an affliction of leprosy, whose means are insufficient in his cleansing."
verses.14:33: And the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.14:34: "When you enter the land of Canaan, which I am giving to you as a possession, and I place an affliction of leprosy in a house in the land of your possession,
verses.14:35: then the one who owns the house shall come and report to the priest, saying, 'Something like an affliction has appeared to me in the house.'
verses.14:36: Then the priest shall command that they empty the house before the priest goes in to inspect the affliction, so that everything in the house will not become unclean; and after that the priest shall go in to inspect the house.
verses.14:37: And he shall inspect the affliction, and look, the affliction is in the walls of the house—sunken patches, greenish or reddish—and their appearance is lower than the wall.
verses.14:38: Then the priest shall go out of the house to the entrance of the house and shut up the house for seven days.
verses.14:39: And the priest shall return on the seventh day and inspect it; and look, the affliction has spread in the walls of the house.
verses.14:40: Then the priest shall command that they pull out the stones in which the affliction is and throw them outside the city into an unclean place.
verses.14:41: And he shall have the inside of the house scraped all around, and they shall pour out the plaster that they scraped off outside the city into an unclean place.
verses.14:42: Then they shall take other stones and bring them in place of the stones, and he shall take other plaster and plaster the house.
verses.14:43: But if the affliction returns and breaks out in the house after the stones have been pulled out, and after the house has been scraped, and after it has been plastered,
verses.14:44: then the priest shall go in and inspect it, and look, the affliction has spread in the house; it is a destructive leprosy in the house—it is unclean.
verses.14:45: And he shall tear down the house—its stones, its timbers, and all the plaster of the house—and carry them outside the city to an unclean place.
verses.14:46: And whoever enters the house during all the days that he has shut it up shall be unclean until the evening.
verses.14:47: And the one who lies down in the house shall wash his garments, and the one who eats in the house shall wash his garments.
verses.14:48: But if the priest indeed goes in and inspects it, and look, the affliction has not spread in the house after the house has been plastered, then the priest shall declare the house clean, for the affliction has been healed.
verses.14:49: And to purify the house he shall take two birds, cedar wood, crimson yarn, and hyssop.
verses.14:50: And he shall slaughter the one bird into a clay vessel over living water.
verses.14:51: Then he shall take the cedar wood, the hyssop, the crimson yarn, and the live bird, and dip them in the blood of the slaughtered bird and in the living water, and sprinkle onto the house seven times.
verses.14:52: Thus he shall purify the house with the blood of the bird, with the living water, with the live bird, with the cedar wood, with the hyssop, and with the crimson yarn.
verses.14:53: And he shall release the live bird outside the city into the open field; so he shall make atonement for the house, and it shall be clean.
verses.14:54: This is the law for every affliction of leprosy and for a scall,
verses.14:55: and for leprosy of a garment and of a house,
verses.14:56: and for a swelling, for a rash, and for a bright spot,
verses.14:57: to instruct concerning the day it is unclean and the day it is clean. This is the law of leprosy."
verses.15:1: Then the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.15:2: "Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, 'Whenever any man has a discharge from his flesh, his discharge is unclean.
verses.15:3: And this shall be his uncleanness in his discharge: whether his flesh flows with his discharge or his flesh is sealed off from his discharge, that is his uncleanness.
verses.15:4: Every bed on which the man with the discharge lies shall become unclean, and every article on which he sits shall become unclean.
verses.15:5: And anyone who touches his bed shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and he shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:6: And the one who sits on the article on which the man with the discharge sits shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and he shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:7: And the one who touches the flesh of the man with the discharge shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and he shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:8: And if the man with the discharge spits on one who is clean, then that person shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and he shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:9: And every saddle on which the man with the discharge rides shall become unclean.
verses.15:10: And whoever touches anything that is beneath him shall be unclean until evening; and the one who carries those things shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and he shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:11: And anyone whom the man with the discharge touches without having rinsed his hands in water shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and he shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:12: And an earthenware vessel that the man with the discharge touches shall be broken, while every wooden article shall be rinsed in water.
verses.15:13: When the man with the discharge becomes clean from his discharge, he shall count for himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his garments and bathe his flesh in living water; then he shall be clean.
verses.15:14: On the eighth day he shall take for himself two turtledoves or two young pigeons, and he shall come before the LORD to the entrance of the tent of meeting and give them to the priest.
verses.15:15: And the priest shall offer them, one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering; thus the priest shall make atonement for him before the LORD on account of his discharge.
verses.15:16: Now if an emission of semen goes out from a man, he shall bathe all his flesh in water, and he shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:17: And every garment and every piece of leather on which there is an emission of semen shall be washed in water, and it shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:18: As for a woman with whom a man lies with an emission of semen, they shall bathe in water, and they shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:19: When a woman has a discharge, and the discharge in her flesh is blood, she shall remain in her menstrual separation for seven days; and whoever touches her shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:20: Everything on which she lies during her menstrual separation shall become unclean, and everything on which she sits shall become unclean.
verses.15:21: And whoever touches her bed shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and he shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:22: And whoever touches any article on which she sits shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and he shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:23: And if it is on the bed or on the article on which she is sitting, when someone touches it, he shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:24: And if a man actually lies with her so that her menstrual separation comes upon him, he shall be unclean for seven days, and every bed on which he lies shall become unclean.
verses.15:25: Now if a woman has a discharge of her blood flowing for many days outside the time of her menstrual separation, or if she has a discharge beyond her menstrual separation, for all the days of the discharge of her uncleanness she shall be as in the days of her menstrual separation; she is unclean.
verses.15:26: Every bed on which she lies throughout all the days of her discharge shall be to her like the bed of her menstrual separation, and every article on which she sits shall be unclean, like the uncleanness of her menstrual separation.
verses.15:27: And whoever touches them shall become unclean; he shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and he shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:28: And if she becomes clean from her discharge, she shall count for herself seven days, and afterward she shall be clean.
verses.15:29: On the eighth day she shall take for herself two turtledoves or two young pigeons, and bring them to the priest, to the entrance of the tent of meeting.
verses.15:30: And the priest shall offer the one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering; thus the priest shall make atonement for her before the LORD on account of the discharge of her uncleanness.'
verses.15:31: So you shall set the sons of Israel apart from their uncleanness, in order that they do not die in their uncleanness by defiling My tabernacle that is in their midst.
verses.15:32: This is the law for the one who has a discharge and for the one from whom an emission of semen goes out, becoming unclean by it,
verses.15:33: and for the woman who is unwell in her menstrual separation, and for the one who has a discharge, for both the male and the female, and for a man who lies with an unclean woman."
verses.16:1: Then the LORD spoke to Moses following the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they came near before the LORD and died.
verses.16:2: And the LORD said to Moses, "Speak to your brother Aaron that he not come at just any time into the holy place inside the curtain, before the atonement cover that is upon the ark, so that he does not die; for I will appear in the cloud above the atonement cover.
verses.16:3: With this Aaron shall come into the holy place: with a young bull from the herd for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering.
verses.16:4: He shall put on a holy linen tunic, and linen undergarments shall be upon his flesh; he shall fasten a linen sash around himself and wrap on a linen turban. These are holy garments, so he shall bathe his flesh in water and put them on.
verses.16:5: And from the congregation of the sons of Israel he shall take two male goats for a sin offering and one ram for a burnt offering.
verses.16:6: Then Aaron shall present the bull of the sin offering that is for himself, and make atonement for himself and for his household.
verses.16:7: He shall take the two male goats and station them before the LORD at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
verses.16:8: And Aaron shall cast lots over the two male goats, one lot for the LORD and one lot for Azazel.
verses.16:9: Then Aaron shall present the goat on which the lot came up for the LORD and offer it as a sin offering.
verses.16:10: But the goat on which the lot came up for Azazel shall be stationed alive before the LORD to make atonement over it, in order to send it away to Azazel into the wilderness.
verses.16:11: Then Aaron shall present the bull of the sin offering that is for himself and make atonement for himself and for his household, and he shall slaughter the bull of the sin offering that is for himself.
verses.16:12: He shall take a censer full of coals of fire from the altar before the LORD, and his two handfuls of finely ground fragrant incense, and bring them inside the curtain.
verses.16:13: He shall put the incense on the fire before the LORD, and the cloud of incense shall cover the atonement cover that is over the testimony, so that he does not die.
verses.16:14: He shall take some of the blood of the bull and sprinkle it with his finger on the front of the atonement cover on the east side; and in front of the atonement cover he shall sprinkle some of the blood with his finger seven times.
verses.16:15: Then he shall slaughter the goat of the sin offering that is for the people and bring its blood inside the curtain, and do with its blood just as he did with the blood of the bull, and sprinkle it upon the atonement cover and in front of the atonement cover.
verses.16:16: So he shall make atonement for the holy place on account of the uncleannesses of the sons of Israel and on account of their transgressions, regarding all their sins; and likewise he shall do for the tent of meeting, which resides with them in the midst of their uncleannesses.
verses.16:17: No person shall be in the tent of meeting when he enters to make atonement in the holy place until he comes out; and he shall make atonement for himself, for his household, and for the entire assembly of Israel.
verses.16:18: Then he shall go out to the altar that is before the LORD and make atonement for it; he shall take some of the blood of the bull and some of the blood of the goat and put it on the horns of the altar all around.
verses.16:19: With his finger he shall sprinkle some of the blood upon it seven times, and he shall cleanse it and sanctify it from the uncleannesses of the sons of Israel.
verses.16:20: When he has finished making atonement for the holy place, the tent of meeting, and the altar, he shall present the live goat.
verses.16:21: Then Aaron shall lay both of his hands on the head of the live goat and confess over it all the iniquities of the sons of Israel and all their transgressions, in all their sins; and he shall put them on the head of the goat and send it away into the wilderness by the hand of a designated man.
verses.16:22: The goat shall carry upon itself all their iniquities to an isolated land, and he shall release the goat in the wilderness.
verses.16:23: Then Aaron shall come into the tent of meeting and take off the linen garments that he had put on when he went into the holy place, and leave them there.
verses.16:24: He shall bathe his flesh in water in a holy place and put on his garments; then he shall come out and offer his burnt offering and the burnt offering of the people, and make atonement for himself and for the people.
verses.16:25: And he shall turn the fat of the sin offering into smoke on the altar.
verses.16:26: And the one who releases the goat for Azazel shall wash his garments and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he may enter the camp.
verses.16:27: And the bull of the sin offering and the goat of the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy place, shall be carried outside the camp, and they shall burn with fire their hides, their flesh, and their dung.
